name: 202. Live content route honours the named provider (live named provider)
description: A recording download names only a session id, so on the bare route the caller may name the provider with ?provider= or x-model-provider, as the file, batch and video routes accept. Provider resolution runs before the session is looked up, so an unknown session id reaches it with nothing spent: a provider without live support or an unknown name is refused with 400, the query parameter wins over the header, and the /openai prefix wins over both. Sideband attach shares the resolver but is a WebSocket upgrade the harness cannot drive; tests/live covers it.

item.name: [EXPECT-400] /v1/live/sessions/{id}/content?provider=anthropic resolves the named provider before the session lookup - live named provider

exec: pm.test('Status is 400: the named provider is resolved before the session is looked up', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(400); });
pm.test('The refusal names the provider the caller asked for, which serves no live sessions', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('does not support live sessions: anthropic'); });

item.name: [EXPECT-400] /v1/live/sessions/{id}/content with x-model-provider naming an unconfigured provider is refused - live named provider

exec: pm.test('Status is 400: an unknown provider name is refused', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(400); });
pm.test('The refusal says the named provider is not configured', function () {
var j; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { pm.expect.fail('refusal is not JSON: ' + pm.response.text()); return; }
var msg = typeof err === 'string' ? err : String((err && err.message) || '');

item.name: [EXPECT-400] /v1/live/sessions/{id}/content ?provider= wins over a conflicting x-model-provider header - live named provider

exec: pm.test('Status is 400: the query parameter named Anthropic', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(400); });
pm.test('The query parameter, not the header, named the provider', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('does not support live sessions: anthropic'); });

item.name: [EXPECT-404] /openai/v1/live/sessions/{id}/content ignores x-model-provider: the integration prefix wins - live named provider

exec: pm.test('Status is 404: the request reached OpenAI, which has no such session', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(404); });
pm.test('The prefix, not the header, chose the provider', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('anthropic'); });
